summary.text: Chris Hart is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 73 since 2007 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, Hart serves on the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hart earned a B.A. from Howard University in 1997 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina in 2000, and he served in the Army National Guard from 1989 to 1998.
His legislative biography lists him as an attorney and an adjunct professor at Benedict College, and as a member of the National Bar Association and the South Carolina Bar Association.
Hart advanced from the June 9, 2026, Democratic primary and faces Republican Allen Robertson in the November 3 general election.
